content: Always consult your healthcare professional for advice regarding your specific health needs and the use of this product. Ensure you obtain complete information from your healthcare provider about this medication and its suitability for your condition. Precautions: Before using mebendazole, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary. Mebendazole can pass into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Long-Term Use: If you are taking this medication for an extended period, your doctor may recommend laboratory and/or medical tests, such as complete blood counts and liver or kidney function tests, to monitor your health. Attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Hygiene for Pinworm Infections: Pinworm infections are highly contagious. To prevent reinfection, practice strict hygiene measures. Wash your hands frequently, especially after using the bathroom, and disinfect toilets daily. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose and are taking more than one dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your specific health needs. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information, as individual plans and formulary details may vary.
